title: Diagnostic
description: Generated by `cargo run -p tmark-ir --example schema` from the Rust types of tmark-ir; do not edit. Design `05-diagnostics.md` §One type. The CLI prints `file:line:col: severity code: message`.

message.description: One sentence, no trailing period, names the construct.

related.description: Other locations involved, with a label each (the other definition of a duplicate key).

Code.description: Stable diagnostic identifiers. Design `05-diagnostics.md` §Who emits what.

oneOf.description: Spec §Roles: an attribute list with no host element.
Spec §Roles: a role head not followed by `[` or `(`.
Design C4: a brace group followed by `[` or `(` whose name is not a role. Literal text; a hint against typos.
Design C7: a `Kind:` line with no float to attach to.
Design C10: `{include}(…)` inside a paragraph; only the block form exists.
Spec §Container directives: a `:::` fence without its closing line.
Spec §Div: a `::: name` whose name is unknown.
Spec §Data directives: an info string whose second word is not a node word.
Spec §Front matter: the YAML island does not parse.
Spec §Front matter: an unknown key under a validated namespace (`declare`, `sources`, `features`).
Appendix "Deprecation schedule": a deprecated spelling.
The tokenizer failed on the file (a bug in it, never in the input): the document is one paragraph of the text. AGENTS.md: "parsing never fails".

Appendix "PyMdownX compatibility profile": a spelling of the profile the parser recognises but does not implement yet (milestone 5), so it is literal text: critic markup, wiki links, fancy list markers. Loud rather than silent (P4).
Spec §Tabs: a `::: tab` outside `::: tabs`; wrapped in a `tabs` of one.
Spec §Table rung 5: the payload of a `yaml table` or `yaml table-config` fence is not YAML or not a mapping; the fence stays a code block.
Spec §Table rung 5: a key the table schema does not know (top level, `table:`, a column, a cell, a separator, a named row). Python `extra="forbid"`.
Spec §Table rung 5: `columns` missing, not a list, fewer than two, a descriptor that is neither a name nor a mapping, a group without a name or without columns.
Spec §Table: an `align` value outside `l|c|r|j` and their long forms.

Spec §Table rung 5: a value of the wrong shape (a row that is neither a list nor a mapping, an empty row, a cell mapping without `value`, `rows`/`cols` below 1, `long` that is not a boolean or `auto`, a width that is not text).
Spec §Table rung 5: a row that does not cover the declared columns (extra cells, missing cells, a list longer than its group).
Spec §Table rung 5: a span that collides with another, runs past the last column or row, or is not acknowledged with `~`.
Spec §Table rung 5 (named-row mode): a key that names no top-level data column.
Spec §Ref: a key found in no registry.
Spec §Cite: a key present in two registries.
Spec §CounterItem: an undeclared counter prefix.
Spec §Anchor: a prefix that disagrees with its host (`{#tbl:x}` on a figure).
Spec §Counters: the same label defined twice.
Spec §Cite: a `[^key]` citation shadowed by a real footnote.
Spec §Cross-document references: an inventory that cannot be loaded.
Design `06-registries.md`: an inventory whose hash no longer matches.
Spec §Includes: an included file that cannot be loaded.
Spec §Header: a reference to a heading's implicit id, which changes whenever the title is edited; write `{#id}`.

Spec §Anchor: a numeric reference (`@id`, `[](#id)`) to an anchor whose host has no counter (a span, a `Div`, a sub-figure of an unnumbered container); it renders the anchor's text or its id. Write a textual reference `[text](#id)`.
Spec §Ref: "Figure 3" typed in prose.
Spec §Ref: "above" or "below" used as a reference.
Spec §Anchor: a caption id without the recommended prefix.
Spec §Conformance and deviations: an X-class construct under the strict profile.
Appendix "Deprecation schedule": a deprecated front-matter key.
Spec §Para: a leading strong span promoted to a lead-in.
Spec §Header: a heading level skipped.
Spec §Table rung 5: a `placement` that is not made of `hHtbpT!`.
Spec §Table: a width that is empty or a percentage outside (0, 100].
Spec §Table: column percentages that add up to more than 100.
Spec §Foreign directive: a dotted `::: a.b` directive, which the HTML and paged writers drop.
Spec §Emoji and icon shortcodes: a Material icon shortcode, which print drops.
Spec §Feature registry: a spelling gated on a feature that is off (`^^x^^` without `inline.insert`), literal text.

Fix.description: A text edit the LSP can apply: replace `span` with `replacement`. Design `05-diagnostics.md` §Fixes. A `NodeEdit` variant arrives with `tmark-fmt`.
